sections.section: RULES - North West Frontier Province (Distribution of Arms and Ammunition for Patrol Duty) Rules 1972
sections.description:
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (DISTRIBUTION OF ARMS AND AMMUNITION FOR
PATROL DUTY) RULES, 1972
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (DISTRIBUTION OF ARMS AND AMMUNITION FOR
PATROL DUTY) RULES, 1972
(Amendment)
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 17th March, 19901
No.SO (ARMS)I-ID-II/84, dated 28-1-1990.--In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 read with section 16 of the
North-West Frontier Province (Villages and Small Towns Patrol Protection)
Ordinance, 1972 (N.-W.F P: Ord.IX of 1972), the
Government of the. North-West Frontier Province, is
pleased to direct that in the North-West Frontier Province
(Distribution of Arms and Ammunition for Patrol Duty) Rules, 1972, the
following amendment shall be made, namely:
In
Schedule `B', in column 3,----
(a)
for the figure "500" against serial No.1,
the figure "100(1" shall be substituted;
(b)
for the figures "3000" and "25"
against serial No.2, figures "15000" and "50" shall
respectively be substituted;
(c)
for the figures "3000" and "25"
against serial No.3, the figures "15000" and "50" shall
respectively be substituted; and
(d)
for the figure "500" against serial No.4,
the figure "101" shall be substituted.
